entry.summary:
• category: AMR → Indoor service
  • note: Re-checked 2026-11-17: otsaw.com still does not serve the product page (otsaw.com/transcar/ -> 404). OTSAW's own TransCar brochure (opened as a PDF, OTSAW Group, Sept 2023) gives TransCar as a tricycle-drive hospital AGV: speed 0.1-1.6 m/s, max load capacity 500 kg, 1706 x 616 x 346 mm, IP54, LiFeMnPO4 battery, battery life <=12 h. The brochure does not print 'K2' on its spec table, so only payload (500 kg, also stated by OTSAW for the K2 in its own FHA-HoReCa 2024 post, opened) is filled; dimensions, speed, IP and runtime are left null although the brochure lists them for the TransCar family. 'TransCar K2' is named in that OTSAW post and in an SEC-filed Swisslog/Otsaw agreement. Category note: it is an AGV (fixed routes) for trolley transport. → Re-checked 2026-11-17: otsaw.com still does not serve the product page (otsaw.com/transcar/ -> 404). OTSAW's own TransCar brochure (opened as a PDF, OTSAW Group, Sept 2023) gives TransCar as a tricycle-drive hospital AGV: speed 0.1-1.6 m/s, max load capacity 500 kg, 1706 x 616 x 346 mm, IP54, LiFeMnPO4 battery, battery life <=12 h. The brochure does not print 'K2' on its spec table, so only payload (500 kg, also stated by OTSAW for the K2 in its own FHA-HoReCa 2024 post, opened) is filled; dimensions, speed, IP and runtime are left null although the brochure lists them for the TransCar family. 'TransCar K2' is named in that OTSAW post and in an SEC-filed Swisslog/Otsaw agreement. Category note: it is an AGV (fixed routes) for trolley transport. Category moved from AMR to Indoor service on 2026-11-28 (issue #109): it carries meals, linen, medication and waste inside hospitals, a facility service task, not factory or warehouse logistics.
